Talk to our event experts with over 25 years of experience. Schedule a call with sales FAQ Frequently asked questions Everything about working with eventfirst — pricing, process and onboarding. My company has a strict procurement process. How do we onboard eventfirst? Very easily. Since eventfirst is your single contracting party, your procurement team only needs to onboard us once. We take care of all payments to underlying suppliers. In your Enterprise workspace, procurement also controls approvals and budgets, sets preferred and blocked suppliers and uploads your framework agreements and rates. How quickly do I get offers? You get a first event concept and a curated list of suitable suppliers for it right away. Binding offers for individual services usually arrive within 24 hours, and within 72 hours for larger events. What does eventfirst do exactly? eventfirst is an all-in-one AI platform for corporate events and your extended event-planning team. With sourcing, we find and negotiate individual services for your event. With full event management, we plan, source, negotiate and coordinate your entire event, with on-site support if you want it. We combine AI speed with human expertise. What types of suppliers do you work with? Our network includes more than 30,000 suppliers: hotels, conference venues, unique locations, restaurants, caterers, AV and technical teams, ground transport providers, entertainers, facilitators, and team-building partners. Do you handle travel logistics? We handle all ground logistics (shuttles, buses, private transfers, trains). We do not book flights. Is there a minimum group size or budget? We typically require a minimum event budget of €5,000. We support everything from small executive meetings (5–10 people) to large company offsites and conferences with 500+ attendees. Who can use eventfirst? We exclusively serve companies, agencies, associations and clubs. The platform is built for event planners in in-house event teams and departments as well as for procurement. We do not organize private or consumer events. Can I use eventfirst for attendee management? Yes. You can upload your participant list to our platform. Our AI automatically generates a personalized event website, manages rooming lists, and creates a centralized logistics overview for your event. How can I become a partner with eventfirst? Want to attract more clients and scale your event business? Partner with eventfirst and get direct access to global corporate event inquiries. Contact us at partner@eventfirst.com to join our supplier network.
